title: Phase 6 Payload — Code Review & PR Resolution
description: Payload when phase=6, status=ok (FR-020..FR-022). Root-cause fixes, precise modifications, professional PR reply ending in a confirmation marker.

location.description: e.g. function name or line anchor.

addresses.description: The specific review comment or CI failure this fixes (FR-021).

pr_reply.description: Concise professional reply ending with a confirmation marker ✅ or 🛠️ (FR-022).

ci_root_cause.description: Single root cause of the CI failure, or null when none applies (FR-021).
